`final class TextConverter`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.font.converter` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [TextConverter.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/font/converter/TextConverter.java)

The registry of the text converters, which turns any value into the string a text shows.

## Description

A `String` shows as it is; any other value goes to the last registered [`ITextConverter`](/reference/text/itextconverter/) that supports it, otherwise to its `toString()`.
